title: Graded differential on retained resolution representatives
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, and $I$ a bicomplex with complex index in $\mathbf Z$ and resolution index in $\mathbf N$ [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Set $J$ equal to the identity-mapped, resolution-extended-by-zero, flipped bicomplex [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. Let $\epsilon:K\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)$ be a chain map and $C=\operatorname{Cone}(\epsilon)$ [lem-pur-quasi-iso-cone-acyclic]. Let $F$ be a decreasing subcomplex filtration of $C$ [def-sp-filtration], and write $i_{p,n}:(F^pC)^n\to C^n$ and $q_{p,n}:(F^pC)^n\to G_p^n$ for its inclusion and graded quotient projection, where $G_p=F^pC/F^{p+1}C$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Write $u_n:K^{n+1}\to C^n$ and $v_n:\operatorname{Tot}(J)^n\to C^n$ for the cone inclusions, $j_{r,s,n}:J^{r,s}\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)^n$ for the diagonal inclusion when $r+s=n$, and $j^0_{r,s,n}$ for that inclusion extended by zero when $r+s\ne n$. Fix $b\in\mathbf Z$, and assume for every $q,n$ that $F^qC^n=(\operatorname{im}(u_n)\text{ if }q\le n+1,\text{ else }0)+\sum_{s=\max(b,q)}^n\operatorname{im}(j^0_{n-s,s,n}v_n)$. Each extension identification $E_{s,r,t}:(I^{s,\bullet}\text{ extended by zero})^t\cong I^{s,r}$ is the canonical one for $t=r$. Assume $I^{s,\bullet}=0$ for $s<b$. Let $p,m,m'\in\mathbf Z$, $r\in\mathbf N$, $r+p=m$ and $m+1=m'$. Suppose $l:I^{p,r}\to(F^pC)^m$ and $l':I^{p,r+1}\to(F^pC)^{m'}$ satisfy $li_{p,m}=E_{p,r,m-p}^{-1}j_{m-p,p,m}v_m$ and $l'i_{p,m'}=E_{p,r+1,m'-p}^{-1}j_{m'-p,p,m'}v_{m'}$. Then $lq_{p,m}d_{G_p}^{m,m'}=d_{I^{p,\bullet}}^{r,r+1}l'q_{p,m'}$. This concerns specified lifts of the resolution summands and assumes no comparison isomorphism.

proof.text: If p<b, evaluation of the zero column shows that the source I^{p,r} is zero, so both morphisms vanish. Otherwise r+p=m implies p+1≤m+1. The (m-p,p+1) summand inclusion belongs to F^{p+1}C^{m+1} by the finite image-supremum formula. Factor it through the monic next-step inclusion using its image subobject.

Cancel the monic inclusion of F^pC^{m+1} to compute the step differential on l. The right cone inclusion is a chain map. Expand the total differential as D₁+D₂ on the diagonal inclusion. The resolution part has coefficient 1; the complex-index part has coefficient (-1)^{m-p}. The extension differential formula and the equation for l' identify the first part with d_I followed by l'. The second part is the signed horizontal differential followed by the next-step factorization from step 1. Canonical extension identifications at equal indices agree by equality elimination and proof irrelevance.

Use chain compatibility of q to replace l q d_G by l d_step q. The next-step inclusion followed by q is zero by the cokernel relation, so the horizontal term vanishes. The remaining term is d_I l' q, as asserted.

theorem cartanEilenberg_cone_graded_resolution_representative
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    (K : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (b : ℤ)
    (hIbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (I.X s))
    (aug : K ⟶ (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone aug))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
        (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
          ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl aug).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
        (Finset.Icc (max b p) n).sup (fun s ↦ imageSubobject
          ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotalOrZero
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (n - s) s n ≫
              (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f n)))
    (p m m' : ℤ) (r : ℕ) (hr : (r : ℤ) + p = m) (hmm' : m + 1 = m')
    (l : (I.X p).X r ⟶ (F.step p : CochainComplex A ℤ).X m)
    (l' : (I.X p).X (r + 1) ⟶ (F.step p : CochainComplex A ℤ).X m')
    (hl : l ≫ (F.step p).arrow.f m =
      (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
        (((𝟭 A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X p))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := r) (i' := m - p)
        (by change (r : ℤ) = m - p; omega)).inv ≫
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotal
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m - p) p m (by change (m - p) + p = m; omega) ≫
      (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f m)
    (hl' : l' ≫ (F.step p).arrow.f m' =
      (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
        (((𝟭 A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X p))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := r + 1) (i' := m' - p)
        (by change ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = m' - p; push_cast; omega)).inv ≫
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotal
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m' - p) p m' (by change (m' - p) + p = m'; omega) ≫
      (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f m') :
    l ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f m ≫
        (F.gradedPiece p).d m m' =
      (I.X p).d r (r + 1) ≫ l' ≫
        (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f m'
